claims: Creator scanned a vibe-coded app and found admin passwords and API keys leaking in plain text over a public API endpoint
AI tools are not good at securing things unless you force it on them
You should run a security scan after every set of changes
how_to_steps: Clone your app to your computer via GitHub
Open it in Claude Code, Codex or similar
Prompt the agent: install and use the [Gitleaks-style] secret-scanning tool to check the app for leaked secrets and sensitive information
Repeat after every batch of changes; download the free security prompt at opichi.com/resources

No terminal, no scanner output, no repo shown
cta: Like and save; comment what else you do to secure AI-coded apps; tutorial on YouTube, prompt at opichi.com/resources

relevance.why: Haji ships vibe-coded apps solo; a secret-scanner in the loop is a low-effort guard against the exact failure (leaked keys) described.

implement_score.why: Add gitleaks (or trufflehog) as a pre-commit hook / CI step and a one-line CLAUDE.md rule to run it before commits. ~20 minutes, no cost. Don't bother with the creator's prompt download.

verify: Is 'Better Leaks' actually Gitleaks (gitleaks/gitleaks) or a different tool? Confirm name and that it is maintained
